promoted.description:
Promote a designated Redis replica to master, demoting the current master.
Semantically a switchover; the state name is a verb-form past participle
per the core-module convention (installed/running/promoted/restarted).

new_master_sid.description: SID of the replica host (an existing incarnation host) that should become the new master.

password.description: Redis password (vault-ref, resolved by the Keeper).

timeout.description: Timeout for establishing new replication, seconds.
